blocks.instructionalPurpose: Sustained reading with words explained in context. Learner action: Read the county-capital pairs; distinguish county names from capital names without inferring geography.

accessibility.textAlternative: Liberia county-capital register. Lofa: Voinjama. Gbarpolu: Bopolu. Grand Cape Mount: Robertsport. Bomi: Tubmanburg. Montserrado: Bensonville. Bong: Gbarnga. Nimba: Sanniquellie. Margibi: Kakata. Grand Bassa: Buchanan. River Cess: Cestos City. Grand Gedeh: Zwedru. Sinoe: Greenville. River Gee: Fish Town. Grand Kru: Barclayville. Maryland: Harper.

accessibility.nonColorCue: Use the labels, quantities and text equivalent; color is supplementary.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Use the static text equivalent and record each model state on paper.
